title: ID0443388-DC/SI-D/DE-[multi] Serial Number not transmitted via BootNotification
description:
Reported issue:
the specified chargers do not transmit their serial number via OCPP boot notification.
Please set serial number of the chargers, so that we see the serial in our CPMS.
Solution: Reinsert the Serial Number in the SCB front page of the charger

additional_info.subject: AW: ID0443388-DC/SI-D/DE-[multi] set serial number in CPMS CRM:00315002924
additional_info.body:
Hi Francisco!
The chargers who do not send their serial number via OCPP boot notification are the 14 chargers that are related to this case (0443388).
The dedicated field in the boot notification does not exist, therefore our CPMS cannot process the serial number.
There seems to be a specific field in charger config that is missing or empty currently.
Since firmware version 6.0.3 the chargers are able to send their serial number.
Please compare the config with the charger jX6vQY – this charger transmits the serial number correctly.
Case no. ID443906 is related to an issue with the external load management. There are 10 chargers, which have lost their LMS configuration. This is a different case and does not relate to this issue here.
Thanks and kind regards,
Marius Schneider

additional_info.subject: AW: ID0443388-DC/SI-D/DE-[multi] set serial number in CPMS CRM:00315002924
additional_info.body:
Hi Francisco,
thank you for informing about the change in charger ID. We were not aware of that; the service reports usually do not highlight this info.
This is important for us to know since we are often asked for the charger ID and therefore need to know this, especially when there’s a change in the ID.
The backend provider is in this case not relevant, since the OCPP boot notification is a notification coming from the charger to CPMS without any request from our backend. Therefore, it is charger behavior and must be related to its config.
Enclosed you find the payload of the last boot notification, sent from charger lcoEO2.
The serial number should be a specific key-value pair in the JSON payload (please see also screenshot from pSJ5Cc as a comparison, how it should look like).
Kind regards,
Marius
